SoftwareVersions: BIDS Conversion by TAPAS PhysIO Toolbox (R2025a-v9.1.0)

cardiac.Description: continuous pulse measurement (processed: normalized amplitudes, padded for scan duration, scan trigger extracted, filtered respiratory data)

respiratory.Description: continuous amplitude measurements by respiration belt (processed: normalized amplitudes, padded for scan duration, scan trigger extracted, filtered respiratory data)

trigger.Description: continuous binary indicator variable of scan volume trigger signal detected by PhysIO

cardiac_pulse.Description: continuous binary indicator variable of cardiac pulses (peaks) detected by PhysIO
